verses.text: That's why I, Paul, am locked up for Christ Jesus for your sake, you Gentiles.
You've probably heard how God handed me this grace assignment for you—
God revealed the mystery to me, as I wrote briefly before.
When you read it, you'll see that I understand the mystery of Christ.
People in earlier generations weren't shown this mystery the way the Spirit has now revealed it to God's holy apostles and prophets:
through the Good News, Gentiles are fellow heirs, part of the same body, and share the promise in Christ Jesus.
God made me a servant of this Good News by the gift of his grace, working through his power.
Though I'm the least of all God's people, this grace was given to me: announce Christ's riches to the Gentiles—riches too deep to measure—
and help everyone see how God is carrying out this mystery, hidden for ages in the God who created everything through Jesus Christ.
God's plan is that, through the church, his many-sided wisdom would now be shown to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly places.
This matches his eternal purpose, carried out in Christ Jesus our Lord.
In Christ, through faith in him, we can approach God freely and confidently.
So please don't lose heart over the troubles I'm facing for you. Those troubles are part of your honor.
That's why I kneel before the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ—
the one every family in heaven and on earth gets its name from—
asking him, from the riches of his glory, to strengthen you with power through his Spirit deep inside you;
asking that Christ would make his home in your hearts through faith, as you take root and build your foundation in love. 💛
Then, together with all God's people, you'll have strength to grasp how wide, long, high, and deep Christ's love is—
and to know that love, even though it goes beyond what we can fully understand, so you'll be filled with all God's fullness.
Now to the One who can do so much more than anything we ask or imagine, through the power already working in us—
to him be glory in the church and in Christ Jesus, through every generation, forever and ever. Amen. 🙌
